behaviour: A dry white wine strengthened with spirit and scented with herbs, bark and peel. It is sharper and more aromatic than plain white wine. A splash dissolves the browned bits in a pan, and it is boiled down so that its raw taste of spirit goes and only the acid and the herbal scent are left. A cook who has no white wine often reaches for it in a cream sauce or a fish dish.

contains.basis: Wine may be cleared with gelatine or isinglass.
Wine may be cleared with gelatine, isinglass, egg white or milk protein.
Wine may be cleared with isinglass, which comes from fish.
Wine may be cleared with egg white.
Wine may be cleared with milk protein.

safety.note: The mix of herbs and spices is a house secret and is not listed on every bottle. It is recorded here as holding none of the other facts, which a person must check on the bottle in hand.
